title: Fourier Series Generated by Additive Prime Factor Functions
summary: We introduce a rigorous arithmetic--spectral construction associating planar geometric objects with additive prime factor statistics. Let $\mathrm{sopfr}(n)$ denote the sum of prime factors of $n$, counted with multiplicity, and define the summatory function $B(x) = \sum_{n \le x} \mathrm{sopfr}(n)$. It is known that $B(x) \sim \frac{π^2 x^2}{12 \log x}$ as $x \to \infty$. We show that $B(n)$ admits an exact prime-indexed decomposition $B(n) = \sum_{p \le n} p\, v_p(n!)$, where $v_p(n!)$ denotes the $p$-adic valuation of $n!$.
